 THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 25.10.2018 PASSED IN MVC NO. 23/2015 ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MACT, TURUVEKERE, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION  THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FURTHER ORDERS, THIS DAY, JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:

CORAM: HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA  -3-  NC: 2024:KHC:37463  MFA No. 5752 of 2021  ORAL JUDGMENT Memo filed by learned counsel for appellants seeking permission to not press the appeal is on record.
2.

Learned counsel Sri.Mallikarjuna Reddy representing Sri.Gurudev Prasad K.T, learned counsel on record for appellants submits that the appellants are not interested to pursue the matter and therefore, the appeal may be dismissed.
3. In the light of the memo filed and having considered the submission thus made, the appeal stands dismissed without costs as not pressed.
4. The interlocutory application vide IA No.1/2021 is also dismissed consequently.
